Description: Received signal strength from each of the 520 access points.  Original sentinel 100 (not detected) is replaced by −110 dBm.
Binary flag: 1 if the AP was *not* detected in this scan, 0 if it was.
Number of access points detected in this scan (count of WAP columns with original value ≠ 100).
Strongest RSSI among detected access points in this scan.
Mean RSSI of the detected access points (excludes missing / imputed values).
Standard deviation of RSSI among detected APs.  Captures signal diversity.
Difference between the strongest and weakest detected RSSI.  Larger range may indicate open areas.
